contexts.text: The ways of Zion do mourn () = that there are no longer any truths from good.

Abraham came to mourn for Sarah and to weep for her () = the state of the Lord's grief on account of the night as to the truths of faith in the Church... To mourn regards grief on account of night as to goods; to weep, as to truths.
The must shall mourn () = that truth will cease. AE 376:20.
The days of mourning for my father will approach () = the inversion of the state.
Sadness and internal mourning produce weeping and wailing.
To rend the garments = mourning on account of truth destroyed. AC 4763:4. AC 4763:5. AE 395:9.
To put sackcloth on the loins = mourning on account of good destroyed. Illustrated.
He mourned over his son many days () = the state of mourning for good and truth destroyed... here, a state of great mourning, because it is said many days.
As this mourning can be appeased only by interpretations from the Word... to comfort = the interpretations which are made from the sense of the letter.
I will go down into the grave to my son mourning () = that the Ancient Church would perish.
His father wept for him = interior mourning. Explained.
They rent their garments = mourning... here, on account of lost truths from proprium. Explained.
When this inversion of state takes place, there is mourning; for they are then let into temptation, whereby the things of the proprium are weakened...
He made a mourning for his father seven days () = the end of the grief.
And the inhabitant of the Land, the Canaanite, saw the grievous mourning in the threshing-floor of Atad () = the apperception of the grief by the good of the Church... The mourning = the grief.
The land which shall mourn () = the Church.

As the mourning represented spiritual mourning, which is mourning on account of the deprivation of the truth and good of the Church, therefore in their mourning they induced baldness on their heads. Illustrated.
By the mourning upon all the roofs () is signified the vastation of all the goods with those who are meant by Moab... and by the mourning in the streets is signified the vastation of all the truths.
The people... mourned () = their grief on account of non-eminence over others.
Mourning (is an expression) which is predicated of good, (or) evil... weeping, of truth, (or) falsity.
Clothed in sackcloth = mourning meanwhile on account of the non-reception of truth. AR 492:2, Illustrated.

The mourning of the Sons of Israel was represented by various things... as that they put ashes upon their heads, rolled themselves in the dust, sat long upon the earth in silence, shaved themselves, wailed and howled, rent their garments, and also put on sackcloth, besides other things; and each thing signified some evil of the Church with them, on account of which they were being punished. When they were being punished, they represented their repentance by such things. AE 637:3.

So much torment and mourning give her () = (in the same proportion) they have after death internal grief from being cast down and derided, and from want and misery... Their mourning after death is thence.
I shall not see mourning () = that they can never be bereaved of these things... That they do have mourning on this account after death, see just above. AE 1122.
Mourning, which is internal grief (at the Last Judgment) from want and misery in place of opulence. Signified.

They cast dust upon their heads, and cried out weeping and mourning... () = their interior and exterior grief and mourning, which is lamentation... To weep = the mourning of the soul; and to mourn, the mourning of the heart.

Death shall be no more, neither mourning, nor crying out... () = that the Lord will take away from them all... fear of damnation; of evils and falsities from Hell... By the mourning which shall be no more is signified the fear of evils from Hell. For mourning = various things, according to the subject treated of.
The priests were not permitted to mourn () because so there would have been represented before the choir of Angels mourning over evil.
Some Sirens... are transmitted into sad and mournful Societies, so that they have nothing but mourning garments: thus are they broken...
Therefore it is said to comfort all those who mourn ().

As the mourning in the Churches before the Lord's Advent... represented spiritual grief of mind on account of no truth and good as these things were represented by the mourning among them, therefore they then went in black. Illustrated.
For the mourning with those who were of the Ancient Churches represented grief on account of truth and good lost or destroyed.
Mourning, and lamentation () = on account of the Church vastated as to truths and as to goods.
Clothed in sackcloth = mourning on account of the non-reception of Divine good and Divine truth. Explained.
To induce baldness = mourning on account of all things of intelligence being destroyed.
To mourn, and to wither () = to perish and to be dissipated through cupidities.
The devastation (of these Knowledges) is signified by to mourn, etc. ().
The desolation (of the Church) is described by to mourn, etc. ().
The ways of Zion do mourn = that Divine truths are no longer sought for.
Mourning () = when there is no longer any truth; thus when the Church has been desolated.
Here, () mourning is said on account of truth destroyed; and wailing, on account of good destroyed.

The merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her () = the mourning and grief of those who procure for themselves the things which pertain to that religiosity that they may gain honours and wealth.
(They shall stand) weeping and mourning () = grief of soul and of heart; weeping = grief of soul; and mourning, grief of heart, (which) are distinguished as are truth and good...
